title: Karla Turner and her family as alien and MILAB abductees

tellings.quote: made Turner unique was that she was an abductee and her family.

plain: The writer Karla Turner, author of the books Taken and Into the Fringe, is said to have been abducted by aliens along with her family, and also to have been a MILAB case, a term for people who say they were taken by the military or by humans working alongside aliens. The researcher Tim Alberino describes this to Michels without naming a source, saying what "made Turner unique was that she was an abductee and her family," and he places her alongside the abduction researchers Budd Hopkins and Barbara Bartholic. To him her case matters because she researched the experience from the inside.
